title: Genetic architecture and inheritance patterns of Leber hereditary optic neuropathy among 419 Chinese pedigrees carrying the ND4 11778G>A mutation.
intervention: Genetic modifier analysis of m.11778G>A LHON pedigrees
design: observational pedigree genetic analysis (no therapeutic intervention evaluated)

outcomes.name: disease penetrance
outcomes.effect_text: D4j, M7, M9, M10 significantly enriched in maternally inherited families with elevated disease penetrance

outcomes.name: mitochondrial dysfunction
outcomes.effect_text: synergistically aggravate mitochondrial dysfunction together with m.11778G>A

outcomes.name: nuclear and X-linked modifier genes
outcomes.effect_text: nuclear modifiers PRICKLE3 and YARS2, as well as X-linked sex-specific regulatory factors, are also identified
